about: Fixed sentence templates for the justification paragraph at the top of each layer. A sentence is used when its 'when' conditions hold and every {placeholder} it names has a value; the first matching sentence marked 'open' starts the paragraph, then the layer sentences in order, then the shared closing sentences, up to 5 sentences. A sentence marked 'filler' is added only when the paragraph would otherwise have fewer than 3 sentences. When hosting is provided by the BaaS, only the sentences with 'provided' are used. Placeholders are filled from the project's answers, the derived numbers and the knowledge-base fields of the pick (each knowledge-base item lists its sources). Conditions: kind (the pick's kind), provided (hosting is provided by the BaaS), plus the knowledge-base line conditions (stack_any, stack_none, app_type, realtime, compliance_any, cloud_preference, india, eu, multi_region) and seo, consistency, read_write (answer values).
